title: Continuous batch tuner & workload sampler for safe apply/rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a continuous batch-tuning service that profiles production traffic, suggests incremental batching and KV-cache parameters, and applies config changes through a safe rollout/rollback path. The service should operate as a low-risk closed-loop controller: 1) collect lightweight telemetry (latency and token distribution, request concurrency, model variant), 2) compute heuristics and delta-cost/latency tradeoffs for candidate batching profiles, 3) propose changes and optionally apply them via staged rollout with automatic rollback on regressions. Background: Existing autotune experiments require heavy offline profiling and manual rollouts. This ticket scopes an always-on sampler + tuner to reduce manual ops and capture temporal workload shifts (seasonality, hourly spikes) so recommendations stay accurate. Out of scope: deep kernel-level optimizations and model retraining. Core components: workload sampler, profile aggregator, heuristics engine (cost/latency estimator), safe-apply controller (canary, metric gates, rollback), observability dashboards, and integration points for Dedicated and Private deployments. Success metrics: net token cost reduction (system-level) without exceeding latency SLOs or increasing error rates.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler runs in prod on a small fraction (<1%) of hosts and provides hourly summarized profiles to the aggregator
Heuristics engine outputs deterministic candidate profiles with estimated cost delta and expected p50/p95 latency impact
Safe-apply controller supports canary rollout (1%, 5%, 25%), automated metric gates, and automatic rollback on latency or error regressions
End-to-end test simulating a 3x traffic spike shows the controller stalls apply and surfaces a rollback with root cause
Grafana dashboard surfaces recommended profile, recent trials, and cost/latency diff for each experiment
Integration tests for Dedicated and Private run and pass in CI with config mock
tasks: Design public API for sampler telemetry payloads (schema + sampling budget)
Implement lightweight sampler agent and deploy to staging (collect token length distribution, request headers, model tag)
Build aggregator job to compute time-windowed workloads and fingerprint profiles
Prototype heuristics engine: greedy profile explorer + conservative candidate filter
Implement safe-apply controller with canary schedule and metric gates (p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token cost)
Create observability dashboards and alerts (Grafana + tracing links)
End-to-end QA runbook and automated rollback tests
Write migration guide for Dedicated/Private ops and docs for SDK/Console integration
